svg.title: NBA structure and path to championship
svg.desc: Diagram showing NBA's 30 teams split into Eastern and Western conferences, each with 3 divisions, qualifying for playoffs, and meeting in the Finals.

g.text: First to 4 wins in the Finals

svg.text: ℹ︎ Seeds 7–10 play a "Play-In Tournament" to decide the last 2 playoff spots per conference
